# [v0.92.2][C-SDLC v3][SIM-09] Run the authorized 30-journey transition pilot

## One completed result

Execute one bounded, separately authorized post-resume pilot and retain the complete consecutive-journey scorecard with an independent disposition. The result feeds SIM-UMBRELLA. A protocol, synthetic replacement for real journeys, deployment receipt alone, or 30 cherry-picked successes cannot complete the task.

## Dependency and separate authority

Depends on the complete reviewed/rehearsed SIM-08 packet and its current passing SIM-07 qualification. Canonical source is `docs/milestones/v0.92.2/cognitive-sdlc/C_SDLC_V3_SIMPLIFICATION_PLAN.md`, especially measurement contract and coordinated transition procedure, plus SIM-09 in `WP_EXECUTION_SPECIFICATIONS_v0.92.2.yaml`. Launch baseline: `ace209ad9c701a855d165da817164ff60a755203`; re-resolve the qualified activation candidate before any action.

Creating or assigning this issue is not writer-pause or activation authorization. Before live effects, record explicit operator authorization naming the candidate, writer-pause window, affected C-SDLC scope, transition owner, recovery authority and bounded pilot. Require the reviewed packet, passing independent qualification, resolved owners, fence and snapshot before live conversion. Runtime/provider/cloud services are not paused or mutated by this issue. Paid resource use, release and public publication require their own scope/authority.

## Owned paths and execution boundary

Own `.csdlc/evidence/<assigned-issue-number>/sim-09/` for authorization references, pre/post candidate and installed provenance, transition/readback receipts, append-only attempt/journey inventory, scorecard, adverse-event dispositions and independent review. Execute the exact installed commands validated in SIM-08 through native C-SDLC v3; do not manufacture state or receipts. Operational issue work remains in its separately bound owner worktrees. This issue observes those journeys and coordinates only the approved transition, not their feature implementations. Shared telemetry/measurement helpers belong to prior SIM owners; defects return to their owner rather than expanding this pilot into an implementation bundle.

## Fixed pilot denominator

Use the first **30 consecutive eligible issue journeys after authorized resume**. This is the plan's minimum exposure, selected as one bounded pilot rather than an open-ended rollout. Freeze eligibility and exclusions in SIM-08 before activation; enroll each eligible journey at entry, before its outcome is known. Include failures and abandonments in those same 30; they are not replaced. Keep every command attempt/retry/guard denial for each journey, and separately count excluded and censored observations with reasons. Do not fabricate work to fill the count or claim completion while enrolled journeys have unclassified outcomes. If fewer than 30 eligible journeys become available, the pilot remains incomplete. Any additional exposure or reset is a separately authorized decision with the original record preserved.

## Acceptance

- Execute the SIM-08 procedure under explicit authority: drain/classify in-flight work, fence old writers, snapshot and convert, verify exact census/semantic equivalence/evidence/binding/installed readback from primary and genuine worktree, reject old requests, then resume only after all paused checks pass. Record exact candidate and immutable receipts.
- Record all 30 eligible journeys and every attempt, including faults, expected denials, waits, retries, abandonment and missing data. Capture operation/correlation/intent, before/after issue version, effects, invalidation cause, outcome/reason, wall/monotonic duration and wait owner. Stratify by work type, dependency, proof profile and scale; report eligible, attempted, completed, failed, abandoned, censored and excluded counts without conflating them.
- Evaluate the adopted scorecard against retained same-corpus pre-transition evidence where comparable: prepared-start time, successful terminal journeys, finite recovery, avoidable retries, manual inputs, observability and preserved guards. Record environmental changes and non-comparable cells explicitly. Real pilot observations do not replace required deterministic pre-resume proof.
- On safety/authority/evidence-integrity failure, freeze affected C-SDLC writers according to the authorized protocol, preserve all observations, and route a reviewed repair. Before new operational writes, only the rehearsed authorized restore is permitted; after a new-format write or remote effect, automatic snapshot restore is forbidden and reviewed reconciliation is required. Do not restart the denominator to erase faults. If continuation requires a changed candidate/protocol, retain this pilot as incomplete/adverse and obtain a new explicit decision.
- Independently review the complete inventory and scorecard. Every adverse or abandoned journey has a disposition and owner. Successful completion means the bounded run and its truthful final assessment are complete; it does not manufacture a sprint pass. Report pass/fail/not-proven for each measure, with unresolved required findings blocking SIM-UMBRELLA's successful completion.
- Limit reliability claims to exposure. Zero failures in 30 independent comparable journeys permits approximately a 9.5% one-sided 95% upper bound; it does not prove 99% reliability. Correlation weakens those assumptions; pre/post comparisons are observational, not causal savings proof. Recommend additional exposure only from the retained results, without automatically launching it.

## PVF and stop conditions

PVF: operational qualification; deterministic local accounting/duplicate/omission/unauthorized-activation denial checks plus observational live C-SDLC journey evidence. Resource profile: approved same-host lifecycle activity and its explicitly authorized GitHub operations, no implicit inference/cloud spending; required final SIM sprint gate. Negative proof includes incomplete denominator, duplicated/replaced journey, missing adverse outcome, stale qualification, absent pause authority, unfenced writer, and unsafe restore rejection. Declare test lane/role/determinism/resources/gate in the coupled proof inventory.

Stop on missing activation authority, invalidated qualification or runbook, competing writer, incomplete census, lost observations, integrity failure or unapproved resource scope. Retain an honest blocked/incomplete pilot rather than simulating live exposure or weakening the protocol.


## Canonical sprint links

Planning and issue-creation owner: #864.
Sprint umbrella: #866 (coordination; does not gate SIM-01 startup).
Execution prerequisite: #874 (SIM-08), with accepted merged output before dependent execution.

Creation contract reviewed at `ed2a93338c92fda62ba63761d56af21b50483eb4`. Issue creation is not implementation start or live activation.
